$comment: Machine-readable project state. The human-readable companion is MEMORY.md; keep the two in agreement. Validated by scripts/check-memory-freshness.sh in CI.
next_task: Start Docker, run the 14 integration tests against real Postgres/Redis, then verify one live provider completion end to end.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.evidence: Workspace, full schema migrations with monthly partitioning, typed config, CI, health endpoints verified against a running gateway, ADRs 001-006.

phases.name: Auth, keys, orgs
phases.evidence: argon2id auth, sessions, API key CRUD with LRU+Redis+PG tiers, audit log, org/member management, dashboard signup/login/keys pages. 14 integration tests written (run in CI).

phases.name: Core gateway
phases.evidence: Nine provider adapters, full twelve-stage pipeline, rate limiting, budgets, BYOK, shared key pool, usage worker, Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboard.

phases.name: Optimization engine
phases.evidence: Classifier 98% on 100 labelled fixtures, router with conservative defaults, exact + semantic cache, compressor, circuit breakers, savings attribution. verify-phase.sh 3 passes.

phases.name: Dashboards, billing, launch prep
phases.evidence: Stripe webhook verification, invoice assembly with an independent fee-consistency check, budget alerts, admin console, landing page, docs, savings CSV export, runbooks.
remaining: P4.8 EXECUTE the load test against staging

phases.name: Launch + provider expansion
phases.evidence: All five expansion providers tested. Classifier v2 trained via a real dump/fit pipeline. Status page endpoint. Launch playbook written.
remaining: P5.5 wire the scheduled digest job

phases.name: Enterprise readiness
phases.evidence: Offline license validation with grace period, SCIM 2.0 shapes handling both Okta and Entra deprovisioning, SSO assertion validation with replay detection, per-tenant HKDF keys, region pinning, admin TOTP with the RFC 6238 vector.
remaining: Wire SCIM and SSO HTTP routes
Verify against a real Okta or Entra tenant

phases.name: Scale + moat
phases.evidence: UCB1 outcome bandit with a 3000-step replay showing it beats static routing. TypeScript and Python SDKs, both verified.

blockers.summary: Docker Desktop was not running, so nothing has been verified against live Postgres, Redis, or Qdrant.
blockers.impact: The 14 integration tests compile and skip locally. CI runs them against service containers.
blockers.workaround: Set AEGIS_TEST_DATABASE_URL to run them. The gateway compiles and unit-tests with no external service.

blockers.summary: No real provider API key was available, so no live completion has been served.
blockers.impact: The pipeline is verified against a mock provider only.
blockers.workaround: Add one key and send a single request; the savings figure can then be checked against the provider bill.

launch_blockers.summary: Seed pricing for 28 models was transcribed during the build, not fetched from provider price sheets. Every row is marked UNVERIFIED.
launch_blockers.impact: Every savings figure and invoice line depends on these numbers.
launch_blockers.action: Follow docs/runbooks/pricing-update.md before billing any customer.

launch_blockers.summary: The k6 load test has never been executed.
launch_blockers.impact: The sub-1ms P99 overhead claim on the landing page is a design target, not a measurement.
launch_blockers.action: Run infra/loadtest/k6-gateway.js against staging and record the P99.

launch_blockers.summary: No backup has ever been restored.
launch_blockers.impact: Part 13 item 6: an untested backup is not a backup.
launch_blockers.action: Run scripts/backup-restore-drill.sh and record the result in MEMORY.md.
